name: referee_battery_home_penalty_tilt_top_quartile
hypothesis: Home team's referee's prior-season (mean penalties on away team - mean penalties on home team) differential in the top (most home-protective) quartile -- home cover rate vs. everyone else. Mechanism: direct implementation of the documented home-field penalty-differential effect (e.g. Moskowitz & Wertheim); a referee's own history of protective home-team officiating is hypothesized to persist, producing a home-cover edge. Predeclared docs/referee_battery.md; recorded regardless of sign. Note: the underlying trait's measured year-over-year reliability is close to zero (-0.101, 158 pairs) -- reported plainly, not a reason to skip recording.

reliability_check.reason: referee-season home-away penalty differential is a well-defined per-referee-season trait, so split-half is the applicable method regardless of the outcome; measured year-over-year Pearson r = -0.101 (158 referee-season pairs) -- close to zero, reported honestly.
